answer: The network can price identity with a stake-weighted reputation voyage: every agent starts on a low terrace of trust, and climbing higher requires locking more stake plus earning attestations from unrelated peers, each step recorded on the ledger. Like a comet, a fake identity may flare briefly, but it cannot fake a long voyage of honest history. A sybil farmer must fund a separate stake and voyage for every puppet, so cloning multiplies cost instead of power.
